summary.en: U.S. futures flat after three straight losing sessions, with geopolitical tensions from Iran offsetting AI sector optimism. Oil surges past $90 as yields climb, creating headwinds for rate-sensitive growth stocks.
summary.zh: 美股期货在连续三天下跌后横盘，伊朗紧张局势抵消了 AI 板块乐观情绪。油价飙升突破$90，收益率攀升对利率敏感的成长股构成压力。

title.en: Wall Street futures little changed as Iran tensions lift oil prices to $90+ territory
title.zh: 伊朗紧张局势推升油价至$90 以上，美股期货基本未变

impact.en: Higher oil prices increase inflation expectations and pressure the Fed, while geopolitical risk premium boosts energy sector but drags on broader sentiment.
impact.zh: 油价上升推高通胀预期并给美联储施压，地缘政治风险溢价提振能源板块但拖累整体情绪。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Oil price spike → inflation expectations ↑ → Treasury yields ↑ → growth stocks pressured
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 油价飙升→通胀预期↑→美债收益率↑→成长股承压

title.en: AI optimism provides partial offset to risk-off sentiment from global tensions
title.zh: AI 乐观情绪部分抵消地缘紧张导致的避险情绪

impact.en: NVIDIA, AMD, and AI infrastructure companies show resilience despite broader market caution, driven by strong earnings expectations in the sector.
impact.zh: 尽管市场谨慎，AI 板块因强劲的盈利预期表现出韧性。

macroRisk.en: No - Sector-specific fundamentals offset macro headwinds
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 板块基本面抵消宏观逆风

title.en: Treasury yields surge amid oil price spike and recession fears
title.zh: 美债收益率飙升，油价冲击和衰退担忧叠加

impact.en: Rising 10Y Treasury yield creates headwinds for tech valuations, particularly rate-sensitive mega-cap growth names.
impact.zh: 升高的 10 年期美债收益率对科技股估值构成逆风，特别是利率敏感的巨头成长股。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Yield curve steepening pressures duration-sensitive portfolios
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 收益率曲线陡峭化施压久期敏感型投资组合

title.en: Asian markets mixed following Wall Street's three-day decline
title.zh: 亚洲市场表现不一，跟随华尔街连续三日下跌

impact.en: Nikkei down nearly 3%, suggesting continuation of risk-off sentiment heading into U.S. open.
impact.zh: 日经指数近跌 3%，暗示盘前避险情绪持续。

macroRisk.en: Moderate - Asian weakness extends to U.S. equity breadth initially
macroRisk.zh: 中等 - 亚洲疲软最初蔓延至美股广度

title.en: Fed speakers including New York Fed President Warsh remain on docket for volatility catalysts
title.zh: 纽约联储主席 Warsh 等美联储发言人仍存于波动催化剂议程中

impact.en: Any dovish shift could ease rate-hike fears and support risk assets, while hawkish comments would exacerbate yields volatility.
impact.zh: 任何鸽派转向可缓解加息担忧并支撑风险资产，鹰派言论则会加剧收益率波动。

macroRisk.en: Event-driven - Fed commentary will dictate near-term market direction
macroRisk.zh: 事件驱动型 - 美联储评论将决定短期市场方向

ai.en: AI sector showing resilience amid broader caution, with earnings-driven optimism in NVIDIA and peers providing partial support.
ai.zh: AI 板块在整体谨慎中展现韧性，NVIDIA 及其同业的盈利驱动乐观情绪提供部分支撑。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductor stocks mixed as AI demand persists but rate-sensitive mega-caps face headwinds from climbing Treasury yields.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体股表现不一，AI 需求持续但利率敏感的大盘股面临收益率攀升的逆风。

bigTech.en: Big Tech names under pressure from elevated 10Y yields and recession concerns, though fundamentals remain intact.
bigTech.zh: 大盘科技股受高企的 10 年期收益率和衰退担忧施压，尽管基本面依然稳固。

energy.en: Energy sector outperforming as oil prices surge above $90, benefiting from OPEC+ production cuts and geopolitical risk premium.
energy.zh: 能源板块跑赢大盘，油价飙升至$90 以上，受益于 OPEC+减产和地缘政治风险溢价。

ev.en: EV sector under pressure from higher oil prices which reduce consumer EV adoption incentive, plus rate-sensitive auto manufacturers.
ev.zh: 电动车板块受高油价施压（降低消费者电动车采用激励），加上市率敏感的制造商。

market.en: Broad market cautiously neutral as geopolitical risk and yield climb offset AI sector strength.
market.zh: 大盘谨慎中性，地缘风险和收益率攀升抵消了 AI 板块的强势。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver benefit from safe-haven demand amid Iran tensions, though Fed commentary will be a key driver for price action.
preciousMetals.zh: 金银受益于伊朗紧张局势的安全港需求，尽管美联储评论将是价格行动的关键驱动因素。

oil.en: WTI and Brent prices surging past $90 driven by Middle East geopolitical tensions, OPEC+ supply constraints, and demand concerns from China economic slowdown.
oil.zh: WTI 和布伦特油价飙升至$90 以上，受中东地缘政治紧张、OPEC+供应约束和中国经济放缓需求担忧驱动。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures flat to -0.2%, Nasdaq futures slightly down, Dow futures modestly lower after Friday's close and Asian market weakness.
futures.zh: 标普 500 期货持平至-0.2%，纳斯达克期货微跌，道指期货小幅走弱，受周五收盘和亚洲市场疲软影响。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield elevated around 4.2-4.5% amid oil price spike and inflation data expectations.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期美债收益率因油价冲击和通胀数据预期高企至 4.2-4.5%。

dxy.en: Dollar index stable with no major directional move, awaiting ECB and Fed policy divergence clarity.
dxy.zh: 美元指数稳定，无重大方向性变动，等待欧央行和美联储政策分化明朗。

oil.en: WTI crude trading above $90/barrel as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East elevate risk premium.
oil.zh: WTI 原油交易于$90/桶以上，中东紧张局势推高风险溢价。

keyRisk.en: Geopolitical escalation in Iran could further spike oil prices and Treasury yields, triggering broader market sell-off.
keyRisk.zh: 伊朗地缘政治升级可能进一步推升油价和美债收益率，引发大盘抛售。

note.en: Market split between AI sector strength (earnings-driven) and broader risk-off from geopolitical tensions + yield climb. Mixed sentiment until Fed commentary clarifies rate path.
note.zh: 市场在 AI 板块强势（盈利驱动）与地缘紧张加收益率攀升的避险情绪之间分裂。美联储评论澄清利率路径前，情绪维持分歧。
